meta_description:
21 likes, 12 comments - swasthisrecipes on September 22, 2026: "This Instant Malai Kulfi is a fresh modern take on the classic Kulfi. While the traditional version takes hours to simmer the milk to semi-solids (rabri) before freezing, this quick no-cook Indian dessert recipe requires only 10 mins of active prep time and a few hours to set in the refrigerator. You get a luxurious and creamy kulfi with ZERO ice crystal formation!
